title: 第25章 再败一人第26章 二公子出手
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 四大宗门接连挑战失败，万尘站在擂台上傲然面对众人，曾经他是众人口中的废物，但是今天他回来了，他以一个全新的面貌回来了。
他要让所有人重新认识他。
王者归来。
看着清风城居民为自己欢呼，万尘心中更是对秦叶充满了感激，要不是被师尊收为徒弟，不要说有今天的修为，恐怕再过两年他就死了。
擂台快要到了尾声，每个宗门还有最后一个名额，如果再挑战失败，那么今年的第一名就会落到清风宗头上。
比赛进行到这里，出乎众人的预料，谁也没有想到万尘会王者归来，一路战到现在，竟然无一人能在他手中接下一招。
“师尊，我来会会他。”擎天宗走出一个气度不凡的青年，得到擎天宗宗主的首肯后，飞身一跃，轻飘飘地落到了擂台上。
“擎天宗，周超。”青年报出了自己的姓名，引起一阵喧哗。
“周超这可是擎天宗的大师兄，听说其天赋很高，已经有练体八重巅峰的实力，擎天宗已经准备立他为少宗主了。”
“听说前段时间，周超闭关出来后，挑战门内四长老，并将其击败，当时在宗门内引起一阵轰动。”
“嘶！擎天宗四长老可是老牌的练体九重境界，周超竟然能战胜他，岂不是他已经突破到了练体九重境了。”
“这么年轻就能突破到练体九重境，有望成就先天强者，我要是擎天宗宗主一定会不惜代价的培养他。”
听到众人对于周超的称赞，擎天宗宗主脸上挂满了笑容，周超的确是擎天宗最出色的弟子，不到20岁的年纪就已经突破到练体九重，相信用不了多久就能突破到练体九重巅峰。接下来，擎天宗就会花大价购买一些辅助丹药，助周超突破先天。
擎天宗若是有了先天强者，足以应对清风宗的挑战了。
今天，本来并没有安排周超挑战，是临时换的人。
“砰砰砰……”
擂台之上，两道身影快速的移动交战，两人打的势均力敌。
“万尘果然是练体九重。”
看到这一幕，很多人心里不由想到。
若是他们知道万尘是压低了修为与周超交战，恐怕都要被惊掉下巴。
两人你来我往了半小时，万尘越战越勇，而周超却是气息有些紊乱。
周超有些郁闷，这万尘到底是什么怪物啊，他施展了好几门擎天宗顶级功法，体内真气消耗很大，而万尘呢体内真气好像是源源不断，没有尽头似的，简直不是人。
擎天宗宗主目光一直盯着场中比赛，很快他看出了不对劲，万尘若是与周超同等境界，绝对不可能这么轻松，也就是说万尘有可能是练体九重巅峰了。
想到这，他也不由地倒吸一口气。
这秦宗主的手段还真是恐怖，这半个月的时间就能将一个废物，变成一个天才，这等手段简直是闻所未闻。
“擎天宗危矣！”
白沙门、黑熊门、铁剑宗三家宗主也都看出了异常。本来这周超有先天之资让他们惊讶了，没有想到万尘更有先天之资。
“唉，没有想到这秦宗主手段竟然如此诡秘……”
“清风宗本来就已经有两名先天强者了，若是这万尘再突破……”
“看来这清风宗崛起之势势不可挡啊。”
三位宗主突然感觉有些落寞，清风城本来就小，原先有六家宗门互相竞争，现在这情势很快就要改变了。
以后这清风城就是清风宗一家独大了。
随着时间过去，周超渐渐不支，攻势越来越慢，明显人都能看得出来，再过一会必然会失败。
content_en:
The four major sects failed to challenge one after another, and Wan Chen stood on the stage and faced everyone proudly. He used to be a waste among everyone, but today he is back, and he is back with a brand new look.
He wants everyone to know him again.
The king returns.
Seeing the residents of Qingfeng City cheering for him, Wan Chen felt even more grateful to Qin Ye. If he hadn't been accepted as a disciple by his master, not to mention his current cultivation level, I'm afraid he would have died in another two years.
The arena is coming to an end, and each sect has its last spot. If the challenge fails again, the first place this year will fall to the Qingfeng Sect.
At this point in the competition, it was beyond everyone's expectations. No one expected that Wan Chen would return as the king. After fighting all the way to this point, no one could take a move from him.
"Master, I'm here to meet him." A young man with extraordinary bearing came out of the Qingtian Sect. After receiving the approval from the leader of the Qingtian Sect, he jumped up and landed lightly on the ring.
"Qingtian Sect, Zhou Chao." The young man announced his name, causing a commotion.
"Zhou Chao is the senior brother of the Qingtian Sect. I heard that he is very talented and has reached the peak of the eighth level of physical training. The Qingtian Sect is ready to make him the young master."
"I heard that some time ago, after Zhou Chao came out of seclusion, he challenged the four elders in the sect and defeated them. It caused a sensation in the sect at that time."
"Hiss! The fourth elder of the Qingtian Sect is a veteran of the ninth level of physical training. Zhou Chao can defeat him. Doesn't it mean that he has broken through to the ninth level of physical training?"
"To be able to break through to the ninth level of physical training at such a young age, he is expected to become an innate powerhouse. If I were the head of the Qingtian Sect, I would definitely train him at all costs."
Hearing everyone's praise for Zhou Chao, the head of the Qingtian Sect had a smile on his face. Zhou Chao was indeed the most outstanding disciple of the Qingtian Sect. He had already reached the ninth level of physical training at the age of less than 20 years old. I believe that it won't take long for him to reach the peak of the ninth level of physical training. Next, Qingtian Sect will spend a lot of money to buy some auxiliary elixirs to help Zhou Chao break through the innate.
If the Qingtian Sect had innate experts, it would be enough to cope with the challenge from the Qingfeng Sect.
Today, Zhou Chao was not originally scheduled to challenge, he was a temporary replacement.
"Bang bang bang..."
On the ring, two figures moved quickly to fight, and they were evenly matched.
"Wan Chen is indeed at the ninth level of physical training."
Seeing this scene, many people couldn't help but think.
If they knew that Wan Chen lowered his cultivation level to fight Zhou Chao, they would probably be shocked.
The two of them went back and forth for half an hour. Wan Chen became more and more courageous as he fought, but Zhou Chao's breath was a little disordered.
Zhou Chao was a little depressed, what kind of monster was this Wan Chen? He had used several top Qingtian Sect techniques, which consumed a lot of energy in his body, but Wan Chen seemed to have an endless supply of energy in his body, and he was simply not human.
The head of the Qingtian Sect kept his eyes on the competition, and soon he saw something was wrong. If Wan Chen was at the same level as Zhou Chao, it would never be so easy, which meant that Wan Chen might be at the peak of the ninth level of physical training.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but take a breath.
Sect Master Qin's methods are really terrifying. He can turn a waste into a genius in half a month. Such methods are simply unheard of.
"Qingtian Sect is in danger!"
The three sect leaders of Baisha Sect, Black Bear Sect and Iron Sword Sect also noticed the abnormality. Originally, Zhou Zhou's innate talent surprised them, but they didn't expect Wan Chen to be even more innate.
"Oh, I didn't expect that Sect Master Qin's methods would be so secretive..."
"Qingfeng Sect already has two innate experts. If Wanchen breaks through again..."
"It seems that the rise of Qingfeng Sect is unstoppable."
The three sect leaders suddenly felt a little lonely. Qingfeng City was originally small and there were six sects competing with each other. Now this situation will soon change.
From now on, the Qingfeng Sect will dominate Qingfeng City.
As time passed, Zhou Chao gradually became exhausted and his offensive became slower and slower. It was obvious to everyone that he would definitely fail after a while.
